title: Human Override - the AI kill switch
lines: AI is everywhere now. In your child's bedroom. In your office. Even in the courtroom.
But who decides when it's switched on?
Midnight. An eleven-year-old, chatting with an AI friend.
Parents switch AI off on the phone, the browser and the family computer. Locked with a PIN.
Exam week. Half the class has a chatbot open in another tab.
Schools block AI on every computer, or on the whole school network.
A client contract, pasted into a public chatbot.
Companies keep their data out of public AI. Only the tools they approve get through.
Case files and witness statements must never end up in a public AI service.
Courts and governments roll out ready-made DNS, firewall and browser rules today.
One switch. One PIN. More than a hundred and fifty AI services blocked. Everything else keeps working.
Human Override. The AI kill switch. Free for browser, Android, Windows and Mac.
